description: Append the third-pass rows to the evidence matrix and update the GO decision table for GO:0005739 and GO:0070733, then render a final summary figure of the reciprocal best-hit margins and the presequence control
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

em=pd.read_csv("table5_evidence_matrix.csv"); print("evidence rows before:",len(em))
em=pd.concat([em,pd.DataFrame([
 dict(citation="This analysis (table11, table12)", evidence_type="computational/evolutionary", stance="supports",
      claim_tested="The ISS transfer of GO:0070733 from Q08968 to O13890 could be paralog confusion rather than orthology",
      key_finding="S. pombe, S. cerevisiae and E. coli each contain exactly one PF02696 protein (O13890 568 aa, Q08968 688 aa, P77649 478 aa); human contains two (Q9BVL4 and unreviewed Q6ICA4). Smith-Waterman reciprocal best-hit test over full reviewed proteomes: O13890 vs 6733 S. cerevisiae proteins gives Q08968 at SW 826 with runner-up 58; Q08968 vs 5129 S. pombe proteins gives O13890 at SW 839 with runner-up 63. Reciprocal in both directions, 14-fold margin.",
      context="Full reviewed proteomes of S. pombe 284812 and S. cerevisiae 559292",
      confidence_and_limitations="High. Restricted to UniProt reviewed entries, so an unreviewed paralog is not formally excluded, though no PF02696 unreviewed entry was returned for either yeast. Orthology licenses the transfer; it does not make the evidence experimental."),
 dict(citation="This analysis (table13, table14)", evidence_type="computational", stance="qualifies",
      claim_tested="Sequence features give independent support for the mitochondrial CC annotation GO:0005739 on sel0",
      key_finding="Net charge of the first 40 residues separates 275 S. pombe transit-peptide proteins from 65 cytosolic ones at AUC 0.930 (mean +5.14 vs -0.60, Cohen's d = 1.99); Arg count AUC 0.802. sel0 scores +2 with 1 Arg and 4 acidic residues, the 5.5th percentile of transit peptides. The positive control fails the same way: Fmp40, experimentally mitochondrial, is at the 6.4th percentile and human SELENOO at the 10.2nd. Stable across windows of 20-60 residues (background AUC 0.916-0.953).",
      context="UniProt reference sets for S. pombe and S. cerevisiae; five SelO-family comparators",
      confidence_and_limitations="Null result, reported as such. The feature has no sensitivity in this family, so it is evidence neither for nor against mitochondrial localization of sel0. Composition-only test; no trained predictor (TargetP, MitoFates) was run, and those could still differ."),
])],ignore_index=True)
em.to_csv("table5_evidence_matrix.csv",index=False); print("evidence rows after:",len(em))

go=pd.read_csv("table6_go_decision_table.csv")
go.loc[go.go_term.str.startswith("mitochondrion"),"evidence_available"]=(
 "No S. pombe localization experiment found; UniProt transit peptide is ECO:0000305 with an undefined end point; "
 "an N-terminal presequence-feature test returned a null because it also fails on the experimentally mitochondrial control Fmp40 (sel0 5.5th percentile, Fmp40 6.4th, human SELENOO 10.2nd of their transit-peptide reference sets)")
go.loc[go.go_term.str.startswith("mitochondrion"),"curator_check"]=(
 "Query MitoMiner v3.1 (PMID:26432830), which includes S. pombe, and PomBase high-throughput localization datasets for SPAC20G4.05c. "
 "Do not cite N-terminal charge or Arg content in either direction.")
m=(go.go_id=="GO:0070733")&(go.recommended_action.str.contains("Retain as non-core",na=False))
go.loc[m,"curator_check"]=(
 "Confirm the ISS with-field points to Q08968. sel0 and Fmp40 are reciprocal best hits over full reviewed proteomes (SW 826 vs runner-up 58; 839 vs 63) "
 "and each genome has exactly one PF02696 gene, so paralog overannotation is excluded. Note human has two PF02696 entries, so any human ISO line should name Q9BVL4 explicitly.")
go.to_csv("table6_go_decision_table.csv",index=False)
print("\nGO decision table updated; rows:",len(go))

# final summary figure from the computed tables
rbh=pd.read_csv("table12_reciprocal_best_hits.csv")
T=pd.read_csv("table14_mts_window_sensitivity.csv")
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,4.6))

ax=axes[0]
for k,(d,ttl) in enumerate(rbh.groupby("direction")):
    pass
dirs=rbh.direction.unique()
w=0.38
for k,dn in enumerate(dirs):
    d=rbh[rbh.direction==dn].sort_values("rank")
    xs=np.arange(len(d))+ (k-0.5)*w
    cols=["#2d6a4f" if r==1 else "#9fb8ad" for r in d["rank"]]
    ax.bar(xs,d.sw_score,width=w,color=cols,edgecolor="k",lw=0.4,
           label=dn.split(" -> ")[0]+" ->"+dn.split(" -> ")[1][:14])
    for x,s,h in zip(xs,d.sw_score,d.hit):
        ax.text(x,s+12,h,rotation=90,ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=7)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(6)); ax.set_xticklabels([f"rank {i+1}" for i in range(6)])
ax.set_ylabel("Smith-Waterman score"); ax.set_ylim(0,1000)
ax.set_title("sel0 and Fmp40 are reciprocal best hits\n(14-fold margin over the runner-up in both directions)",fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="upper right")

ax=axes[1]
sub=T[(T.background=="S. pombe")&(T.window==40)].drop_duplicates("target")
order=["sel0 (O13890, S. pombe)","Fmp40 (Q08968, S. cerevisiae)","SELENOO (Q9BVL4, human)","YdiU (P77649, E. coli)","PsSelO (Q87VB1)"]
own={"sel0 (O13890, S. pombe)":"S. pombe","Fmp40 (Q08968, S. cerevisiae)":"S. cerevisiae",
     "SELENOO (Q9BVL4, human)":"S. pombe","PsSelO (Q87VB1)":"S. pombe","YdiU (P77649, E. coli)":"S. pombe"}
vals=[float(T[(T.target==t)&(T.window==40)&(T.background==own[t])].pct_of_transit_below.iloc[0]) for t in order]
cols=["#c0392b","#2d6a4f","#2d6a4f","#8d99ae","#8d99ae"]
ax.barh(range(len(order))[::-1],vals,color=cols,edgecolor="k",lw=0.4)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(order))[::-1]); ax.set_yticklabels([o.split(" (")[0] for o in order])
ax.axvline(50,color="grey",ls=":",lw=1)
for i,(v,t) in enumerate(zip(vals,order)):
    ax.text(v+1.5,len(order)-1-i,f"{v:.1f}%",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlim(0,60); ax.set_xlabel("percentile within the transit-peptide reference set (window 40)")
ax.set_title("The presequence test fails on the mitochondrial control\n(green = experimentally mitochondrial, grey = prokaryotic)",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("\nprovenance directory now holds:")
print(sorted(f for f in os.listdir(".") if f.endswith((".csv",".png"))))
